verses.text: The wilderness and the dry land will be glad; the desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.

xrefs.text: Then they will say, ‘This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden. The cities that were once ruined, desolate, and destroyed are now fortified and inhabited.’

For the LORD will comfort Zion and will look with compassion on all her ruins; He will make her wilderness like Eden and her desert like the garden of the LORD. Joy and gladness will be found in her, thanksgiving and melodious song.
You will indeed go out with joy and be led forth in peace; the mountains and hills will burst into song before you, and all the trees of the field will clap their hands.
Break forth in joy, sing together, O ruins of Jerusalem, for the LORD has comforted His people; He has redeemed Jerusalem.
In the days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will bud and blossom and fill the whole world with fruit.

verses.text: It will bloom profusely and rejoice with joy and singing. The glory of Lebanon will be given to it, the splendor of Carmel and Sharon. They will see the glory of the LORD, the splendor of our God.

xrefs.text: The glory of Lebanon will come to you— its cypress, elm, and boxwood together— to adorn the place of My sanctuary, and I will glorify the place of My feet.
And how can they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news!”
And in that day it will be said, “Surely this is our God; we have waited for Him, and He has saved us. This is the LORD for whom we have waited. Let us rejoice and be glad in His salvation.”
For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD as the waters cover the sea.

“Behold, the days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when the plowman will overtake the reaper and the treader of grapes, the sower of seed. The mountains will drip with sweet wine, with which all the hills will flow.

verses.text: Strengthen the limp hands and steady the feeble knees!

xrefs.text: Therefore strengthen your limp hands and weak knees.
But I have prayed for you, Simon, that your faith will not fail. And when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers.
Surely you have instructed many, and have strengthened their feeble hands.
And it will be said, “Build it up, build it up, prepare the way, take every obstacle out of the way of My people.”
But I would encourage you with my mouth, and the consolation of my lips would bring relief.

verses.text: Say to those with anxious hearts: “Be strong, do not fear! Behold, your God will come with vengeance. With divine retribution He will come to save you.”

xrefs.text: Be patient, then, brothers, until the Lord’s coming. See how the farmer awaits the precious fruit of the soil— how patient he is for the fall and spring rains.
Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My righteous right hand.
On that day they will say to Jerusalem: “Do not fear, O Zion; do not let your hands fall limp.
Finally, be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.
For the LORD has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.

verses.text: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened and the ears of the deaf unstopped.

xrefs.text: “I, the LORD, have called you for a righteous purpose, and I will take hold of your hand. I will keep you and appoint you to be a covenant for the people and a light to the nations,
When the men came to Jesus, they said, “John the Baptist sent us to ask, ‘Are You the One who was to come, or should we look for someone else?
On that day the deaf will hear the words of the scroll, and out of the deep darkness the eyes of the blind will see.
to ask Him, “Are You the One who was to come, or should we look for someone else?
Then the eyes of those who see will no longer be closed, and the ears of those who hear will listen.

verses.text: Then the lame will leap like a deer and the mute tongue will shout for joy. For waters will gush forth in the wilderness, and streams in the desert.

xrefs.text: Then Jesus told him, “Get up, pick up your mat, and walk.
On the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood up and called out in a loud voice, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to Me and drink.
One day Jesus was driving out a demon that was mute. And when the demon was gone, the man who had been mute spoke. The crowds were amazed,
The mind of the rash will know and understand, and the stammering tongue will speak clearly and fluently.
Then a demon-possessed man who was blind and mute was brought to Jesus, and He healed the man so that he could speak and see.

verses.text: The parched ground will become a pool, the thirsty land springs of water. In the haunt where jackals once lay, there will be grass and reeds and papyrus.

xrefs.text: to open their eyes, so that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins and an inheritance among those sanctified by faith in Me.
They will not hunger or thirst, nor will scorching heat or sun beat down on them. For He who has compassion on them will guide them and lead them beside springs of water.
But whoever drinks the water I give him will never thirst. Indeed, the water I give him will become in him a fount of water springing up to eternal life.
Her towers will be overgrown with thorns, her fortresses with thistles and briers. She will become a haunt for jackals, an abode for ostriches.
Whoever believes in Me, as the Scripture has said: ‘Streams of living water will flow from within him.

verses.text: And there will be a highway called the Way of Holiness. The unclean will not travel it— only those who walk in the Way— and fools will not stray onto it.

xrefs.text: Enter through the narrow gate. For wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and many enter through it.

I will lead the blind by a way they did not know; I will guide them on unfamiliar paths. I will turn darkness into light before them and rough places into level ground. These things I will do for them, and I will not forsake them.
Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.
As obedient children, do not conform to the passions of your former ignorance.
But nothing unclean will ever enter it, nor anyone who practices an abomination or a lie, but only those whose names are written in the Lamb’s Book of Life.

verses.text: No lion will be there, and no vicious beast will go up on it. Such will not be found there, but the redeemed will walk upon it.

xrefs.text: And they will be called the Holy People, the Redeemed of The LORD; and you will be called Sought Out, A City Not Forsaken.
I will make with them a covenant of peace and rid the land of wild animals, so that they may dwell securely in the wilderness and sleep in the forest.

On that day I will make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field and the birds of the air and the creatures that crawl on the ground. And I will abolish bow and sword and battle in the land, and will make them lie down in safety.
Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom He has redeemed from the hand of the enemy
And I will give peace to the land, and you will lie down with nothing to fear. I will rid the land of dangerous animals, and no sword will pass through your land.

verses.text: So the redeemed of the LORD will return and enter Zion with singing, crowned with everlasting joy. Gladness and joy will overtake them, and sorrow and sighing will flee.

xrefs.text: ‘He will wipe away every tear from their eyes,’ and there will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain, for the former things have passed away.
O people in Zion who dwell in Jerusalem, you will weep no more. He will surely be gracious when you cry for help; when He hears, He will answer you.
He will swallow up death forever. The Lord GOD will wipe away the tears from every face and remove the disgrace of His people from the whole earth. For the LORD has spoken.
Was it not You who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep, who made a road in the depths of the sea for the redeemed to cross over?
I will rejoice in Jerusalem and take delight in My people. The sounds of weeping and crying will no longer be heard in her.
